query: SELECT DISTINCT cmt.receivable_id as old_id FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.id IS NULL ORDER BY cmt.receivable_id LIMIT 20;
